name: v2.1.22
body:
## What's Changed
* ci: replace HELM_PUSH_TOKEN with App token and verified API commits by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4409
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 6 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4411
* fix: set Strict-Transport-Security header on TLS responses by @ravi-ciroos in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4414
* chore(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.83.1 to 1.83.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4415
* fix(authn): avoid session CookieStore panic for anonymous UI clients by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4418
* fix: skip invalid repo dirs like lost+found during storage walks by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4419
* chore: fix dependabot alerts by @rchincha in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4424
* feat(sync): sparse multi-arch indexes with periodic platforms filter by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4410
* feat(auth): allow bearer with API keys and OIDC for humans by @matheuscscp in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4243
* ci: fix nightly by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4425
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4426
* fix(zb): create and remove a dedicated temp dir for test blobs by @warisshaikh1 in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4428
* fix(storage): 404 when S3 dedupe stubs resolve to empty content by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4432
* chore: fix dependabot alerts by @rchincha in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4439
* chore: fix dependabot alerts by @rchincha in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4441
* fix(scanner): synchronize trivy scans by @rchincha in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4440
* fix(storage): repair equal-size corrupted manifests on re-upload by @Lcos-000 in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4443
* test(scanner): fix flaky concurrent ScanImage coalescing test by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4446
* fix(gc): validate cosign tag subject digest before use in removeReferrer by @rchincha in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4445
* fix(storage): keep digests pullable after last-tag overwrite (#4444) by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4447
* test: stabilize apikey expiry test by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4450
* fix(api): list tags after a last value that is not a tag by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4448
* chore(deps): bump the go-dependencies group with 12 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4458
* feat(sync): seed on-demand sync sessions with locally-stored blobs by @kwohlfahrt in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4420
* fix(api): return 404 when deleting a manifest in a missing repo by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4460
* fix(storage): list repositories after a last value that is not a repo by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4455
* fix(meta): avoid DeleteSignature panic when signature type is missing by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4459
* feat(sync): add onDemandInBackground for non-blocking on-demand sync by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4451
* feat: add zot healthcheck for distroless container probes by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4461
* chore(deps): bump github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 from 2.3.5 to 2.3.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4462
* feat(server): notify systemd when ready by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4464
* fix(meta): update repo info when index manifests are added after the index by @rophy in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4470
* fix(storage): repair remote dedupe origin on manifest re-upload by @Lcos-000 in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4457
* fix(auth): never proxy local api keys to upstream token service by @matheuscscp in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4473
* fix(api): report the whole upload in the Range of a streamed PATCH by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4476
* fix(api): reject manifest pushes with an invalid path tag by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4475
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4478
* fix(cve): don't read MetaDB inside the scan generator's FilterTags filter by @rophy in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4483
* test: hash test htpasswd credentials with the minimum bcrypt cost by @rophy in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4481
* fix(api): don't overflow the tags/list page end for a large n by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4489
* fix(storage): return an empty referrers index for a namespace without a repo by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4488
* test(stress): pull alpine from project GHCR instead of ECR Public by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4490
* test(gc): start the scheduler before stopping it in runSchedulerUntil by @rophy in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4494
* bug: treat cosign attestations as referrers, not signatures by @FStelzer in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4492
* test(race): fix race condition when running dynamodb tests by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4496
* fix(storage): keep remote dedupe origins from being emptied on rebuild by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4465
* fix(cli): don't ignore SIGCHLD, so child processes can be waited for by @cbirkhold in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4499
* fix(build): tag the image make docker-image builds by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4501
* chore(deps): bump the go-dependencies group with 10 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4503
* fix(storage): avoid remote-cache races during concurrent dedupe uploads by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4504
* fix(storage): classify driver errors as missing, transient, or permanent by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4474
* fix(meta): stop storing signature layers in MetaDB, verify from storage by @FStelzer in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4493
* fix: complete GC when repository metadata is absent by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4500
* test(metrics): disable dedupe in TestPopulateStorageMetrics by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4509
* fix(zb): treat unexpected EOF as a timeout-class failure by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4510
* fix(sync): surface on-demand upstream errors by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4507
* fix(storage): stop collapsing blob I/O to bare ErrBlobNotFound by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4505
* fix(zb): retry timeout-class errors on seed image uploads by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4511
* fix(api): map storage Transient to 503, not client 404 by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4512
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4516
* fix(api): return MANIFEST_BLOB_UNKNOWN for a manifest with a missing blob by @omlahore in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4515
* fix(storage): fail closed on GC, dedupe, and incomplete listings by @andaaron in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4514
* chore: bump zui version by @rchincha in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4519
* fix: improve input validation by @rchincha in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4521

## New Contributors
* @ravi-ciroos made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4414
* @warisshaikh1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4428
* @omlahore made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4448
* @kwohlfahrt made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4420
* @rophy made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4470
* @FStelzer made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4492
* @cbirkhold made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4499
* @mvanhorn made their first contribution in https://github.com/project-zot/zot/pull/4500

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/project-zot/zot/compare/v2.1.21...v2.1.22
